items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I started out doing that and it begin to tax me, so I made my bass player the manager, a guy named Hutchinson.

ctx.x: When you were working with the Collegians did you have somebody serving as the manager and the agent and so on? Or did you do all that yourself?

I started out doing that and it begin to tax me, so I made my bass player the manager, a guy named Hutchinson. He was a tuba -- played the tuba, but he was a good mathematician, could figure, so he took that up, off of me, where I could, you know, concentrate on the musical end of it.
